sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: Archify is an agent skill that turns a description, a question or a code repository into an interactive HTML diagram or one-page explainer. You describe what you want to your coding agent and get a page you can explore, customise and share.
sixtySeconds.problem: Explaining a system, a plan or a diagnosis in chat text is hard to follow. Archify has your agent produce validated diagrams and explainer pages with sources, steps and charts, saved as a single HTML file.
whoFor: Anyone using Cursor, Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it if you want shareable, interactive diagrams from your agent rather than static images or Mermaid snippets. No repository is required; you can start from a sentence.
requirements: Cursor, Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode or GitHub Copilot

overview: Archify turns ideas, questions and plans into interactive HTML. Ask your agent to diagram a web request or map a repository, then keep refining with follow-ups like adding authentication or highlighting a path. Diagrams from repositories link back to the source.

Ask for a one-page answer and Archify builds an explainer: conclusion first, one panel per question, with tables, steps, charts, code and diagrams. Claims cite numbered sources, and repository excerpts are pinned to a commit. Pages come in four styles with light and dark themes and can be exported as long images or printed to PDF.

Install it by asking your agent to read its llms.txt, or with the skills CLI for one or several agents. It may check a fixed stable manifest to show an optional update reminder, but never downloads updates itself.

steps.title: Paste this to your agent
steps.code: Install Archify for me by reading https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tt-a1i/archify/main/llms.txt

steps.title: Install for Cursor
steps.code: npx -y skills@latest add https://archify.si --skill archify --agent cursor --global --copy --yes

steps.title: Or for all five agents
steps.code: npx -y skills@latest add https://archify.si --skill archify --agent cursor --agent codex --agent claude-code --agent opencode --agent github-copilot --global --copy --yes

firstRun.title: Ask for a diagram
firstRun.code:
Use Archify to diagram a web request: Browser calls the API,
the API checks Redis, and a cache miss queries PostgreSQL and fills the cache.

steps.title: Refine it
steps.body: Ask for 'Add authentication', 'Highlight the cache-miss path', or 'Switch to the light theme'.

steps.title: Ask a question as a page
steps.code:
Use Archify to answer as one page: our API's P99 went from 80 ms to 600 ms
while the mean barely moved. What is the likely cause, and how should we investigate?
